name: codesys-conversions
assumptions: STRING_TO_<integer> handles decimal strings like RuSTy's STRING_TO_LINT; CODESYS also accepts type-prefixed literals ('16#FF') and grouping underscores, which are not claimed equivalent.
REAL to unsigned integers outside the target range: CODESYS converts through UDINT/ULINT; the result for negative or too large values is not claimed equivalent.

Integer to BOOL: the generated adapters return TRUE for non-zero values (CODESYS documents this for TIME_TO_BOOL and REAL_TO_BOOL). RuSTy's own BYTE/WORD/DWORD/LWORD_TO_BOOL return the least significant bit; they are not rebound, and their uses are reported as unverified.
DWORD_TO_REAL, LWORD_TO_LREAL, REAL_TO_DWORD and LREAL_TO_LWORD convert the value (CODESYS 'Conversion: Integer'); RuSTy copies the bit pattern, so library calls are rebound to the adapters.
